name: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd
title: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd - 544210 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Emcure FY26 revenue +16.6% to INR9,204 cr with EBITDA margin 19.4% (+80bps), but Q4 domestic growth slowed to 5.2% on Zuventus restructuring; FY27 guided low-to-mid teen growth and 75-100bps margin expansion.

triggers.label: Q4 domestic growth 5.2%
triggers.quote: The domestic business grew by 5.2% to INR977 crores due to softness in Zuventus

triggers.label: FY27 low-to-mid teen revenue growth
triggers.quote: In FY27, we project low to mid -teen revenue growth

triggers.label: Solvent and freight cost inflation
triggers.quote: the solvents that we require for active pharmaceutical ingredients are not available

guidance.quote: In FY27, we project low to mid -teen revenue growth
EBITDA margin expansion will happen as committed between 75 to 100 basis points going forward
the target, is to grow faster than the industry – probably at low double-digits
I think we'll broadly be in that range of INR400 - 425-ish crores.

red_flags.label: Zuventus field force attrition and Q4 domestic slowdown
red_flags.quote: Q4 was softer, mainly due to Zuventus portfolio and team reorganization causing higher attrition

red_flags.label: Net debt rise from acquisitions
red_flags.quote: Net debt as of March 31, 2026, stood at INR1,054 crores.

evasions.quote: Dheeresh, I don't think we'll comment on monthly growth and all.
Zuventus is a different segment altogether.
